Per-coordinate decomposition of the B*_Q6 -> yeast protein-abundance residual: of the 9 synonymous coordinates, 8 are real held-out abundance sources (K_AAA, Arg_AGR, Ile_AUA, Leu_CUN_vs_UUR, Leu_UUA_vs_UUG, Ser_UCR_vs_AGY, Thr_ACR_vs_ACY, f3_stress) and 1 (Ser_UCA_vs_UCG) is not; f3_stress carries the most residual energy (~20% of target, R^2~0.19) followed by Ile_AUA and Thr_ACR_vs_ACY. The measured {te,mrna_stability,turnover} dictionary's projection coverage exceeds the per-coordinate permutation null for the 8 real sources, but a large absolute residual energy remains unexplained per coordinate (e.g. f3_stress ~81% unexplained). Descriptive decomposition, not causal mediation.

The dominant B*_Q6 coordinate f3_stress (a global synonymous first-vs-last-codon direction across all 21 families) carrying ~20% of the abundance-residual energy is only MARGINALLY reachable by independent molecular measurements: the full {te,stability,turnover,localization,ptm,complex,tm,domain,mrna_abundance} readout set reaches best coverage 0.226 vs base {te,stability,turnover} 0.190 (increment +0.036, selection-aware-significant vs null95 0.027), but ~77.4% of f3_stress remains unexplained by ALL available measurements. The dominant frontier is largely orthogonal to current molecular readouts and needs new data/mechanism.

The dominant B*_Q6 coordinate f3_stress's protein-abundance contribution (P_f3, ~20% of target, ~77% orthogonal to static measured readouts) is PARTLY MEDIATED BY RIBOSOME DWELL: per-gene local ribosome occupancy features add held-out delta-R^2 ~0.019 over the {te,mrna_stability,turnover} dictionary (vs fixed-readout permutation null95 ~0.0013), and f3_stress couples positively to dwell (corr 0.162, p~8e-9, reproducing wobble-dwell). Since base already contains measured_te (footprint/mRNA), this is an increment beyond bulk TE -- a dynamic elongation mechanism partly explains f3_stress's abundance effect that static molecular readouts miss.

f3_stress's ribosome-dwell mediation of its protein-abundance contribution (P_f3) is LOCALIZED TO THE 5' TRANSLATIONAL RAMP, not the gene body: 5'-window dwell adds held-out delta-R^2 ~0.023 over {te,stability,turnover} (vs null95 ~0.0016, f3<->5'-dwell corr 0.156 p~3e-8), while 3'/body-window dwell is null (delta-R^2 ~-0.0002), and the joint 5'+3' increment ~= 5'-alone. Supports the translational-ramp hypothesis: the dominant frontier coordinate acts through slow-codon dwell at the 5' ribosome-loading region, increment beyond bulk measured_te.

Biological identity of f3_stress (the dominant B*_Q6 abundance coordinate): decomposing it into 21 synonymous family subcoordinates (exact, sum-consistency l2err~8e-16), 19/21 families are real held-out abundance sources, and the effect is DOMINATED BY GLYCINE (GGN) and ISOLEUCINE (AUU/AUC/AUA) synonymous choices (held-out R^2 0.079/0.063, energy 0.65/0.52), then Arginine (CGN, AGR), Gln, Phe, Thr, Val. So f3_stress is largely a Gly/Ile synonymous-choice axis (Ile-AUA is a known slow/wobble codon), not a uniform 'first-vs-last' artifact.

Cross-organism f3_stress->protein-abundance: the association DIRECTION generalizes near-universally (15/15 organisms held-out-significant vs permutation null after cds-length/total-codon/GC3/20-aa-composition controls, 14/15 POSITIVE; only the archaeon S. solfataricus negative), BUT the effect MAGNITUDE is strongly yeast-dominant. Held-out R^2: yeast 0.168 (clear outlier), lower-eukaryotes/some bacteria 0.01-0.05 (dicty, C.elegans, drosophila, pseudomonas, danio, bacillus), and MAMMALS negligible (human 0.0004, mouse 0.0006, rat 0.0008) -- the latter clear null only via large-n significance (explain <0.1% of variance). So the strong synonymous-codon->abundance coupling is a yeast (+lower-eukaryote/bacterial) phenomenon; in mammals the f3_stress axis is biologically negligible. NOTE: the experiment's pass gate is significance (held_out>null95), which overstates generality at large n; the honest reading is direction-universal, magnitude-yeast-dominant.

Why f3_stress is yeast-dominant: across 15 organisms its effect size = translational-selection strength x directional alignment. (1) Total synonymous-codon selection on abundance (independent 41-col full design) predicts f3 strength (Spearman rho=0.71). (2) f3_alignment sign predicts f3 direction 15/15, incl. the lone negative organism S. solfataricus (anti-aligned). Yeast is strongest because it has BY FAR the highest translational selection (syn_sel R^2=0.39, ~2x runner-up) AND positive f3 alignment (0.24). Counterexample E.coli: high selection (0.22) but f3 near-orthogonal (align 0.046) -> weak f3 (0.006), so alignment matters independently. Mammals: weak selection (0.05-0.08) -> negligible f3. So f3_stress is a 1-D proxy for the organism's codon-level translational selection; it is strong in yeast because yeast's translational selection is strongest. Caveat: n=15, no phylogenetic correction; alignment uses same-organism abundance preferences (direction-agreement partly definitional; non-circular core is the independent selection<->strength rho=0.71).

Cross-organism structure of the abundance-optimal synonymous-codon direction (15 organisms, 41-col synonymous contrast design). conservation_call=CLUSTERED: mean pairwise cosine 0.26 (not conserved>=0.6, not idiosyncratic), organized mainly by GENOMIC GC3 (GC3-delta vs cosine Pearson -0.36) more than by domain (same-domain 0.29 vs cross-domain 0.25). A weak UNIVERSAL CORE direction exists (mean held-out R^2 0.088; max yeast 0.30, E.coli 0.20). Yeast optimizes HARDEST (self-direction R^2 0.40) but in a relatively IDIOSYNCRATIC direction (core alignment 0.38, among the lowest); E.coli is core-aligned (0.77). f3_stress is a crude fixed proxy weakly aligned with everything (f3 vs core 0.26, vs yeast 0.20, vs E.coli 0.22). Caveat: n=15, no phylogenetic correction, optimal direction inferred from abundance-associated contrasts (not causal).

claims.statement: Mechanism for why Window6 boundary set R is biologically avoided (Route L): the 10 R sense-codons are systematically tRNA-POOR (lower dos-Reis tAI weight, from GtRNAdb tGCN+wobble) than non-R sense codons in 31/40 organisms (cross-organism sign test binomial two-sided p~7e-4; 9/40 opposite, so predominant not universal). So the math-defined Window6 boundary R = the translationally non-optimal / tRNA-scarce codons -> they are decoded slowly and selected against -> avoided (Route L). Gives the abstract boundary a real mechanistic biological identity. Deterministic; tAI from GtRNAdb. Caveat: tAI is a supply proxy, not direct decoding-rate; 40 organisms no phylogenetic correction.

Route N: the cross-organism universal optimal synonymous-codon direction (the weak universal core of Route K) is substantially the tRNA-adaptation direction. Across 11 organisms with both proteomes and GtRNAdb tRNA-gene copies, each organism's abundance-optimal direction (full 41-dim synonymous contrast) aligns with its dos-Reis tAI tRNA-supply direction at mean cos 0.267 (median 0.302; cross-organism sign test 10/11 positive, p~5.9e-3; normal-approx p~7e-7), and the tRNA direction ALONE recovers ~43% (pooled held-out R2 ratio 0.434; median per-organism 0.30) of the abundance signal the full optimal direction captures (mean tRNA-alone held-out R2=0.059 vs self R2=0.136). The tRNA direction also aligns with the cross-organism universal core at cos 0.246 (9/11 positive, p~0.033). So translational selection toward tRNA-abundant codons is a MAJOR but PARTIAL (~43%) component of universal codon optimality, not the whole thing -- consistent with f3 residual dominance and the ~24.5% reducibility of B*_Q6. Deterministic; tAI from GtRNAdb tGCN+wobble. Caveat: 11 organisms (proteome intersect GtRNAdb), tAI is a supply proxy not a direct decoding rate, no phylogenetic correction.

Route O: the NON-tRNA component of universal codon optimality is the f3-stress translational-selection axis, NOT GC mutational bias. After Gram-Schmidt-removing each organism's tRNA-adaptation direction from its 41-dim abundance-optimal synonymous direction (Route N), the residual aligns with the f3-stress axis (mean cos 0.139, 10/11 organisms positive, cross-organism sign-test p~5.9e-3, normal-approx p~6e-6) and is ANTI-aligned with the GC3 mutational-bias axis (mean cos -0.073, 10/11 negative). The GC3 and f3-stress reference directions are nearly anti-parallel in this contrast space (cos -0.905), so the residual selects the f3/translational-selection pole over the GC/mutation pole (paired |cos_f3|>|cos_gc| in 11/11 organisms, p~4.9e-4). Combined with Route N (~43% tRNA-adaptation), B*_Q6 codon optimality decomposes into TWO translational-selection mechanisms -- tRNA-supply adaptation + f3-ramp stress -- with GC mutational bias as the opposite pole, not a positive driver. Deterministic; 11 organisms (proteome intersect GtRNAdb). Caveat: f3 cosine magnitude is modest (0.139) though directionally consistent; GC/f3 near-antiparallel means the two readouts are not independent; observational not causal; E.coli/P.aeruginosa/etc lack GtRNAdb (needs_data); no phylogenetic correction.

Route P: universal codon optimality is NOT 2-dimensional (tRNA + f3) -- a universal THIRD selection axis exists. Projecting each organism's 41-dim abundance-optimal synonymous direction onto span{d_tRNA, d_f3} captures only mean 13.0% of its norm^2 (captured_fraction mean 0.130, median 0.102, 11/11 organisms < 0.5); the residual-after-both direction d_perp retains ~93% of the optimal norm. d_perp is NOT noise: systematically positive held-out R2 (mean 0.066, 11/11 positive, p~4.9e-4) recovering ~64% of the self-direction abundance R2 (d_perp/self ratio mean 0.640), and CROSS-ORGANISM ALIGNED (55-pair mean cosine 0.179, 38/55 positive, sign-test p~3.2e-3, normal-approx p~1.6e-6). In 8/11 organisms d_perp alone out-predicts the tRNA+f3 plane combined (two-axis recovers ~40% of self R2). So codon optimality has at least THREE universal selection dimensions; tRNA-supply adaptation (Route N) + f3-stress (Route O) are real but together a MINORITY of the optimal direction's geometry and predictive content. The identity of the third universal axis d_perp is the open frontier. Deterministic; 11 organisms (proteome intersect GtRNAdb). Caveat: cosines modest; observational not causal; no phylogenetic correction; d_perp is an orthogonal-complement residual so its mechanistic identity needs separate characterization.

Route Q: the third universal codon-optimality axis d_perp (Route P) is provisionally identified as the within-synonymous-family USAGE-FREQUENCY axis (preferred-codon bias). Across 11 organisms d_perp aligns with the within-family usage-frequency direction at mean cos 0.128 (11/11 organisms positive, cross-organism sign-test p~4.9e-4) -- the ONLY tested candidate axis clearing the cross-organism gate. Other candidates are weak/non-significant: position composition (pos3_C 0.084 7/11 ns, pos1_C 0.079 8/11 ns), residual GC3 (0.054 9/11 p~0.03 marginal), the other 8 B*_Q6 synonymous coordinates, amino-acid/position composites -- none explain d_perp. So codon optimality has THREE universal selection axes: tRNA-supply adaptation (Route N), f3-stress 5'-ramp translational selection (Route O), and the genome-wide preferred-codon usage-frequency bias (Route Q), the last distinct from tRNA-supply. Deterministic; 11 organisms (proteome intersect GtRNAdb). Caveat: cosine modest (0.128); usage-frequency correlates with expression so part of this reflects the abundance-optimal direction recovering the preferred-codon set, and the deeper driver of usage-frequency beyond tRNA is itself composite/open; observational; no phylogenetic correction. Also exports per-codon d_perp + tRNA-supply vectors in the codon-Q6 6-bit frame (codon_q6_selection_vectors.json) fulfilling the Window6-codon bridge BC5 data request.

Route R: the third universal codon-optimality axis d_perp (Route P/Q, the within-family preferred-codon/usage-frequency direction) is a GENUINE cross-organism SELECTION signal -- NOT a GC/mutational projection and NOT the wobble-decoding axis. GC-null defeat: after orthogonalizing d_perp against the GC3 direction it remains cross-organism aligned (55-pair mean cosine 0.177, 38/55 positive, sign-test p~3.2e-3) and still predicts protein abundance held-out (mean R2 0.071, 11/11 positive, p~5e-4) -- essentially unchanged from pre-orthogonalization (0.179/0.066); GC3 alone gives only R2 0.028. So d_perp is not mutational GC bias. Wobble test: d_perp per-codon loadings do NOT cluster by wobble-decoding class (exact-match vs wobble, NNU/NNC vs NNA/NNG, 2-codon U/C splits) -- not the tRNA-modification/wobble axis. claims.statement: AU-rich-element (ARE) content quantitatively grades measured mRNA stability change (pre-registered test; new layer = 3'UTR/ARE; conclusive crosses_boundary, graded + replicated). Siegel et al 2022 G3 ARE-MPRA (PMC8728028): within-backbone ARE-deletion difference-in-differences in two cell lines (Jurkat n=2242, Beas2B n=226 clean single-ARE deletions joined to their matched reference oligo by parent_control_oligo); readout effect_size_T4T0_GC_resid = GC-residualized stability change of the deletion vs its identical-backbone reference (composition cancels by design except the deleted ARE bases). POSITIVE CONTROL reproduced in BOTH cell lines: deleting the top ARE stabilizes the mRNA (Jurkat mean +0.047, 71.5% positive; Beas2B +0.082, 78.6%; sign-flip permutation p<0.001) — the textbook ARE-destabilization, confirming pipeline sensitivity. GRADING (the non-anchor disconfirmable part): the stabilization magnitude scales with the parent ARE length AND cluster number, Spearman rho positive and SIGN-CONCORDANT across both cell lines (length: Jurkat 0.27 / Beas2B 0.34; cluster: 0.20 / 0.24), all corrected-null p<=0.0005. CRITICAL METHODS NOTE: the initial within-region permutation null was DEGENERATE for this predictor (ARE_length is a per-parent/per-region constant, so within-region label-shuffle cannot break the length<->effect pairing -> p collapsed to 1.0); replaced with a valid pooled label-permutation over deletions (B=2000) that breaks the association, under which the grading is strongly supported. Frozen verdict crosses_boundary: ARE sequence content reads back onto measured decay change in a graded, cross-cell-line-replicated way. Escapes the confound triangle: the readout is a measured reporter decay ratio independent of the ARE annotation (not disguised-e_in); within-backbone deletion DiD + GC-residualization cancels composition (composition-artifact); ARE definition / feature set / verdict thresholds pre-registered and the corrected null is outcome-independent (post-hoc-separator). cannot_claim: synthetic 160nt reporter, not endogenous full-length 3'UTR in native chromatin/transcript context; only 2 immortalized cell lines; only the ARE->decay sub-axis (NOT APA/poly(A)-site choice, miRNA-seed, or translation); effect_size is a reporter T4/T0 ratio, not endogenous half-life; grading uses a pooled label-permutation null (within-region is degenerate for the per-parent ARE-length predictor).

N-terminal mitochondrial-targeting-sequence (MTS) propensity is a reality contact for measured subcellular localization, with its mechanism boundary precisely mapped (pre-registered test; new layer = subcellular localization; conclusive defied_boundary). Itzhak et al 2016 eLife 16950 HeLa spatial proteome (supp4 Master Data, 8696 proteins joined to UniProt sequences by Lead protein ID); labels use ONLY the MEASURED Top Prediction / organellar-marker-set columns (UniProt subcellular annotations NOT used = leakage guard). Stdlib N-MTS propensity over the first 30 aa (net basic (R+K)-(D+E) + Ser/Thr fraction + Eisenberg amphipathic moment); TM count by Kyte-Doolittle. POSITIVE CONTROL reproduced: marker-set mitochondrial (n=242) mean N-MTS 1.51 vs non-mito markers -0.25 (p<0.001); HSPD1 N-MTS 2.77; ATP1A1 8 TMs. MAIN: N-MTS predicts measured-mitochondrion (high-confidence subset n=3030) with AUC 0.741, rank-biserial 0.48, permutation p<0.001, AND survives a length+20-aa-composition+net-charge-controlled permutation (p<0.001 after control = not a composition artifact). SUB-COMPARTMENT DISSOCIATION: matrix/inner mito mean N-MTS 1.26 >> outer-membrane 0.10 (p<0.001) — a composition artifact would not respect this split, but the N-end-presequence mechanism does (matrix/inner use cleavable N-terminal presequences; outer membrane does not). DEFIANCE BOUNDARY (the disconfirmable core): 63 measured-mitochondrial proteins fall below the non-mito N-MTS median, and carrier/tail-anchored proteins are enriched 16.3x among them (p<0.001) — the named defiance set is mechanistically correct (SLC25 carriers A3/A4/A5/A6/A10/A22/A24 using internal signals; TOMM22/40/70A/5 and MAVS tail-anchored/beta-signal; SAMM50 beta-barrel) — exactly the proteins known to import via NON-presequence pathways. Frozen verdict defied_boundary: N-MTS propensity crosses to measured localization for presequence-imported matrix/inner proteins AND its failure boundary is the known non-presequence import classes. Escapes the confound triangle: predictor is pure sequence, label is measured fractionation (not disguised-e_in; leakage-guarded to measured calls); length+composition+charge control + matrix-vs-outer dissociation defeat composition-artifact; MTS rule from prior biology and verdict/defiance thresholds pre-registered (post-hoc-separator). cannot_claim: static steady-state localization, not import rate/flux; HeLa only, no cross-cell/species; N-MTS/TM are stdlib heuristics not experimental targeting assays (crude TM window +-1 error); measured Top Prediction itself has classification error; defiance list limited by sub-compartment annotation completeness.

The m6A-site-load -> mRNA-half-life reality contact is CONSERVED cross-organism (mouse + human; deepens landed claim m6a_site_load_mrna_halflife_boundary_gse163500; conclusive transfers_conserved). Two INDEPENDENT human studies joined: m6AConquer (NAR 2025) orthogonally-validated human single-base m6A sites (135,300 sites, hg38; assigned to gene bodies by coordinate overlap) x RNAdecayCafe (Zenodo 16884513) per-gene SLAM/TimeLapse mRNA half-lives across human cell lines, with the RNAdecayCafe gene model supplying exon_length + GC controls. Per-gene m6A_load (site count) vs log(half-life), frozen direction pre-registered from the mouse result (m6A destabilizes -> negative). RESULT: negative and significant in all three human cell lines after length+GC partial (HEK293 rho_partial=-0.237, HeLa -0.381, K562 -0.389; permutation p<0.001, perm_extreme 0/1000; sign-concordant 3/3). Positive control reproduced (HEK293 raw rho=-0.27 = the known m6A destabilization). Sanity: cross-cell-line half-life correlations 0.68-0.80 (measurement reproducible), m6a_load~exon_length rho=0.38 (the length confound, hence partialled). Frozen verdict transfers_conserved: the count-level m6A->shorter-half-life contact transfers from mouse mESC to human HEK293/HeLa/K562, composition-controlled, with fully independent predictor and outcome data. Escapes the confound triangle: predictor (m6A sites, m6AConquer) and outcome (decay rate, RNAdecayCafe) are physically distinct assays from different labs (not disguised-e_in); length+GC partialled (composition-artifact); frozen direction + permutation null pre-registered (post-hoc-separator). cannot_claim: this human arm is OBSERVATIONAL frozen-direction transfer (no human STM2457/METTL3-inhibition causal arm fetched; it replicates the mouse STATIC arm cross-organism, not the causal arm); m6A_load is site COUNT not occupancy/stoichiometry; sites assigned by whole-gene-body overlap (introns included), not exon-resolved; the m6A-destabilization DIRECTION is known biology, so this measures quantitative conservation of the contact, not a new mechanism; m6AConquer/RNAdecayCafe-specific; human cell lines, not tissues.

Aggregate TF-activator-motif COUNT does NOT cross the readback boundary to predict random-promoter expression beyond GC+dinucleotide composition, even though specific strong motifs do (pre-registered test; new layer = cis-regulatory grammar; conclusive composition_artifact with a working positive control). de Boer et al 2020 (GEO GSE104878) fully-random synthetic yeast promoter MPRA — the carrier is RANDOM DNA so motif occurrence is a coin-flip, the cleanest possible composition control. 8027 high-quality random promoters (canonical 80nt variable region) + 75111 designed/tiling constructs; JASPAR fungi PWMs (REB1/RAP1/GCR1/MSN2-4/GCN4) scored stdlib (log-odds, both strands, 80%-max threshold); sequence and FACS expression-level (EL) are in the same row (no join). POSITIVE CONTROL reproduced (de Boer's established result): individual REB1 (Spearman rho=0.12) and RAP1 (0.073) hit-counts raise EL, and designed REB1/RAP1 copy number is monotone with EL (0 hits 9.07 -> 1 hit 13.9 -> >=2 hits 14.6) — so the pipeline DOES detect real motif effects (the null is not insensitivity). MAIN result: the AGGREGATE activator-hit-count has raw rho=0.12 (and hit-vs-nohit delta +1.22) but after partialling GC + the 16 dinucleotide frequencies, rho_partial = -0.014, which does NOT exceed the dinucleotide-preserving shuffle null 99th percentile (0.020); permutation p=0.64. The shuffle is non-degenerate (677 sequences change motif hits per shuffle). Frozen verdict composition_artifact: the simple aggregate-motif-count statistic is fully explained by base composition in random promoters, even though specific high-affinity activators (REB1/RAP1) causally raise expression. Escapes the confound triangle: random carrier makes motif presence a coin-flip not genomic-context-inherited (not disguised-e_in); the dinucleotide-preserving shuffle null + GC/dinuc partial IS the composition control (and the result is that composition explains it); TF panel/threshold/verdict pre-registered (post-hoc-separator). cannot_claim: synthetic context-free pTpA reporter (episomal-like), not native genomic grammar/chromatin/distal context; single organism (S. cerevisiae), single TSS architecture; PWM log-odds is not thermodynamic occupancy; the null is about the AGGREGATE-COUNT operationalization specifically (individual strong motifs DO act, per the positive control); FACS EL is an 18-bin log estimate.

A crude local-window dsRNA-pairing-score does NOT cross the readback boundary to predict per-site A-to-I editing level beyond repeat-class + local GC, although the ADAR 5'-neighbor signature is reproduced (pre-registered test; new layer = A-to-I RNA editing; conclusive REFUTED with a working positive control). Kleinova et al 2023 NAR (PMC10201426, GSE188842) ADAR1-isoform MEF editome (Supplementary table 2, 3137 differential sites; p150/p110 transfected into ADAR-null MEF); sequence/structure predictors computed PURELY from the mm10 genome (UCSC) around each edited adenosine: 5'-nearest-neighbor base + a local dsRNA-pairing score (longest reverse-complement run in a +-150nt window). POSITIVE CONTROL reproduced: 5'-G fraction 0.029 vs the genomic-A 0.25 baseline (p<0.001 = the canonical ADAR 5'-G depletion), and REP/SINE sites edit more than NONREP (0.067 vs 0.051, p<0.001). MAIN: within repeat-class x local-GC strata, the dsRNA-pairing score does NOT predict editing level (REP rho=-0.022 p=0.83; NONREP rho=-0.022 p=0.66). ISOFORM DiD: p150-specific sites have higher dsRNA-score than p110-specific (6.64 vs 6.45, delta +0.18) in the expected direction but p=0.089 (does NOT reach the pre-registered 0.05; not counted, no goalpost-moving). Frozen verdict REFUTED: the LOCAL-WINDOW dsRNA proxy does not cross beyond repeat-class/GC. Escapes the confound triangle: predictor is genome-derived, not read counts (not disguised-e_in); repeat-class + GC stratified permutation (composition-artifact); 5'-neighbor rule and dsRNA mechanism are a priori, verdict pre-registered (post-hoc-separator); the genetic p150/p110 isoform swap is an exogenous DiD contrast. cannot_claim: the dsRNA-score is a crude local-window proxy (no true thermodynamic fold, no trans/distal Alu pairing that ADAR actually uses), so this REFUTED bounds only the LOCAL-window-detectable component and does NOT disconfirm dsRNA dependence in general; single mouse-MEF ADAR-null-reconstitution overexpression system (n=3 reps), non-physiological; editing levels are bounded/saturating (rank methods used); ~3137 sites; no human/cross-species generalization.

The synthetic-reporter ARE -> mRNA-stability effect TRANSFERS to endogenous human transcripts (deepens landed ARE crosses_boundary, resolving its main caveat 'synthetic 160nt reporter, not endogenous'; conclusive transfers_endogenous). Two INDEPENDENT sources: endogenous human 3'UTR sequences (Ensembl BioMart, longest 3'UTR per gene, 14933 genes) x RNADecayCafe (Zenodo 16884513) per-gene mRNA half-lives (cross-cell-line median over 11 human cell lines; gene model supplies length + GC controls). ARE_density = (overlapping AUUUA + WAUUUAW + collapsed 50nt AU-rich clusters) normalized by 3'UTR kb. Nested OLS: baseline log(half-life) ~ log(3utr_length) + exon_GC + end_GC + 3'UTR-AU-dinucleotide-fraction (R2=0.066) -> +ARE_density (R2=0.083): ARE_density adds significant NEGATIVE incremental explanation (delta-R2=0.017, beta_ARE<0, permutation p=0.0005); the negative ARE_density->half-life relationship holds within ALL FOUR length quartiles (residual Spearman -0.15,-0.13,-0.11,-0.08), so it is not a length artifact. POSITIVE CONTROL reproduced: known ARE-labile transcripts (TNF/FOS/JUN/IL6/MYC/VEGFA, all present) median half-life 0.54h (below the short-tail q25 of 2.13h) while housekeeping (ACTB/GAPDH) median 22.2h, and ARE_density vs log-half-life is negative (partial r=-0.135) — textbook ARE-mediated decay. Frozen verdict transfers_endogenous: endogenous 3'UTR ARE content predicts shorter measured half-life beyond length+GC+bulk-AU, confirming the synthetic-reporter finding generalizes to native transcripts. Escapes the confound triangle: predictor (3'UTR sequence) and outcome (decay rate) are physically independent assays/databases (not disguised-e_in); length+GC+bulk-AU explicitly partialled and within-length-quartile checked (composition-artifact); ARE motif is the textbook pre-specified pattern and verdict pre-registered (post-hoc-separator). cannot_claim: observational, NOT causal and not ARE-specific-mechanism (3'UTR length/AU covary with miRNA sites and secondary structure, not modeled — the claim is only 'beyond length+GC+bulk-AU'); longest-isoform 3'UTR approximation; cross-cell-line median smooths tissue differences; delta-R2 is modest (0.017); RNADecayCafe/Ensembl-specific; human cell lines, not tissues.

N-terminal MTS-propensity localization contact AND its carrier/tail-anchored DEFIANCE boundary are CONSERVED cross-organism human->mouse (deepens landed MTS defied_boundary, resolving its HeLa-only caveat; conclusive conserved_mouse). Itzhak et al 2017 Cell Reports mouse-neuron spatial proteome (Table S4 'Mouse Neuron Spatial Proteome', 9063 proteins; measured Prediction/Marker labels only, UniProt used solely for sequence = leakage guard) joined to mouse UniProt sequences (8944 genes, 505 mito). Same stdlib N-MTS pipeline as the human claim (first-30aa net-basic + Ser/Thr + amphipathic moment). POSITIVE CONTROL reproduced: marker-mito mean N-MTS 1.15 vs non-mito -0.21 (p<0.001); Hspd1 N-MTS 2.76; Atp1a1 4 TMs. MAIN: N-MTS predicts measured mouse-mito (AUC 0.687, point-biserial 0.25, permutation p<0.001) AND survives length+aa-composition+net-charge-matched permutation (effect 0.90 after control, p<0.001). DEFIANCE BOUNDARY conserved: 120 low-N-MTS measured-mito proteins, carrier/tail-anchored enriched 6.4x (Fisher p<0.001) — the named defiance set is the SAME protein families as the human claim (Slc25a3/4/5/13/20/22/23/25/46 carriers, Tomm22, Tomm70a, Samm50 beta-barrel) i.e. mouse orthologs of the human defiance set. Sub-compartment dissociation skipped (mouse sheet has no matrix/inner/outer column, honestly noted). Frozen verdict conserved_mouse: both the N-MTS->localization contact and its mechanistically-coherent failure boundary replicate from human HeLa to mouse neuron. Escapes the confound triangle: predictor is sequence, label is measured fractionation (leakage-guarded to measured Prediction); length+composition+charge controlled (composition-artifact); pre-registered (post-hoc-separator). cannot_claim: static steady-state localization not import rate; mouse NEURON (single tissue/system), not whole-mouse; N-MTS/TM are stdlib heuristics; measured Prediction has classification error; defiance limited by sub-compartment annotation; this is the OBSERVATIONAL cross-organism conservation arm of the human MTS claim, not a mechanism proof.

Charge patterning (Sequence Charge Decoration, SCD) of a protein's primary sequence is a cross-layer reality contact for measured thermal stability (melting temperature Tm) in human cells, beyond amino-acid composition (pre-registered test; new layer = protein thermal stability). FLIP/Meltome Atlas human_cell split (TPP-measured Tm, n=6961, 50-2000aa); the SCD predictor is composition-invariant by construction (charge order, not composition); tested against a composition-stratified label-permutation null + composition/length/disorder residualized partial + held-out protein split; positive control reproduces the known composition effect (low-Tm proteins charge-rich, hydrophobic-poor). Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

claims.statement: PAS cis-element sequence strength predicts measured relative alternative-polyadenylation (APA) usage within genes, beyond GC and intragenic position (pre-registered; new layer = alternative polyadenylation). PolyA_DB v4 (3'READS, 303k PAS / 24740 multi-PAS genes); predictor self-computed from +/-75nt flanking sequence (hexamer + U/GU-rich, prior-frozen, NOT the table's DL PolyaStrength); within-gene relative usage cancels gene expression (e_in); within-gene permutation null + GC/position residualized partial + held-out gene split; positive control reproduces AAUAAA>AUUAAA>A-rich>None usage gradient. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

Local acidic microenvironment (prior-fixed +/-7 window D+E count + charge asymmetry) around already-ubiquitylated lysines does NOT cross the readback boundary to measured Ub-occupancy beyond abundance and local composition (pre-registered; new layer = ubiquitylation occupancy; conclusive negative). Steger 2024 Cell site-resolved Ub-occupancy (PXD037009, ~10410 sites / 2883 proteins, EuropePMC route); measured mean_Ub.occupancy, abundance-controlled (copy_number, iBAQ) + local composition; the partial signal is significant (rho=-0.149) but does NOT survive a within-protein composition-matched null (composition_artifact); positive control reproduces high-occupancy plasma-membrane/SLC enrichment. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

Hydrophobic-residue spatial organization (patch clustering / aggregation hotspots / charge separation), beyond hydrophobic AMOUNT, predicts measured E.coli cell-free solubility (pre-registered; new layer = protein solubility; conclusive bounded). eSOL (Niwa, PURE supernatant ratio, n=3198); predictors prior-frozen and composition-invariant-by-design; the partial signal survives controlling hydrophobic-total + 20aa composition + disorder + abundance (rho=0.075, p=5e-4) AND a composition-preserving per-protein residue-shuffle null (p=0.006), with both positive controls reproduced (hydrophobic-total negative rho=-0.20; SWI rho=0.33), but explains <1% variance -> bounded_descriptor_only. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

3'UTR miRNA canonical seed-match density crosses the readback boundary to predict measured post-transfection mRNA repression (log2FC) beyond 3'UTR length + AU-content + expression baseline (pre-registered; new layer = miRNA target repression; conclusive crosses_boundary). Agarwal 2015 eLife transfection compendium (11 confidently-seed-mapped transfections, 56682 miRNA-gene pairs); predictor = prior-frozen canonical site count (8mer/7mer-m8/7mer-A1), TargetScan seeds; partial rho=-0.133 (p~0) survives a dinucleotide-preserving shuffled-seed null (real -0.133 vs null95 -0.017, p=1e-3), the 8mer>7mer-m8>7mer-A1>no-site dose-series is reproduced, and leave-one-miRNA-out is 11/11 sign-concordant. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

Local flanking-sequence dinucleotide context does NOT cross the readback boundary to predict measured per-CpG methylation cross-individual variance beyond flanking-CpG-count + GC (pre-registered; new layer = DNA methylation; conclusive negative). GSE40279 (Hannum, 656 whole-blood 450K, n_probes=20000 subsample) + Illumina 450K manifest Forward_Sequence; readout = cross-individual variance of beta (the MEAN is the CpG-count trivial baseline, reproduced as positive control: Island vs OpenSea Delta=-0.495, CpG-count->mean-beta rho=-0.44); within exact flanking-CpG-count x GC-quintile bins the context increment is ~0.001 (<max-null 0.002, p_perm=0.053) -> composition_artifact. This is an effect-SIZE negative (~0.1% variance, near zero), not a large-n significance artifact. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

Splice-site sequence strength (frozen MaxEntScan-style 5'SS-9mer + 3'SS-23mer PWM) crosses the readback boundary to predict measured exon inclusion (median PSI) beyond GC + exon/intron length (pre-registered; new layer = alternative splicing; conclusive crosses_boundary). VastDB hg38 (29742 cassette/EX events, median PSI across samples); predictor computed in-script from the 9mer/23mer sequence fields (NOT VastDB numeric scores, NOT PSI-fit -> leakage-safe); partial rho=0.134 (p=1e-3) after GC+length control, survives permutation null (null95 +/-0.011), positive controls reproduced (top vs bottom strength median PSI 97.7 vs 66.4; constitutive-like SS > cassette). Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

5'UTR sequence features (uAUG/uORF count, Kozak context, structure proxy) cross the readback boundary to predict measured mean ribosome load (MRL) beyond GC composition (pre-registered; new layer = translation initiation; conclusive crosses_boundary). Sample 2019 Optimus random-5'UTR MPRA (GSE114002, n=80000, length fixed 50nt -> length confound removed by design); predictor prior-frozen; GC-controlled partial rho=0.650 (p=1e-3), and crucially in the uAUG-free subset (dominant uORF effect removed, n=37272) Kozak+structure still predict MRL beyond GC (rho=0.102, p=1e-3); positive control reproduced (uAUG->lower MRL, Delta=2.09); held-out sign-concordant. Mechanism = 5' initiation, orthogonal to coding-codon TE. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

3'UTR prior-motif density is a real but BOUNDED cross-layer contact for measured mRNA subcellular localization, beyond protein signal-peptide + 3'UTR length/GC/expression (pre-registered; new layer = mRNA localization; conclusive bounded). Fazal 2019 APEX-seq (GSE116008, HEK293T, ERM/NLS compartments, n=16040); the critical confounder is that ER localization's main axis is the CDS signal peptide, so signal-peptide presence (UniProt ft_signal) is controlled AND a no-signal-peptide subset (n=13739) is re-tested: 3'UTR motif still predicts ERM there (rho=0.026, perm p=0.004) and the signal-peptide-controlled partial is significant (ERM rho=0.027 p=1e-3; NLS rho=0.050 p=1e-3); positive controls reproduced (HSPA5/CALR/FN1->ERM+, NEAT1/MALAT1->NLS+, ACTB/GAPDH->ERM-). Effect is very small (rho^2~0.07%, below the crosses effect-size floor) -> bounded_descriptor_only. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

C-terminal degron motif (prior-frozen terminal residue identity) is a real but BOUNDED cross-layer contact for measured FACS peptide stability, beyond bulk amino-acid composition, with a confirmed terminal-POSITION effect (pre-registered; new layer = protein degron stability; conclusive bounded). Voutsinos 2026 KULL cytosolic degron map (212658 30-mer GPS/FACS peptides / 5303 proteins, self-contained); composition-orthogonalized terminal predictor gives partial rho=0.058 (perm p=1e-3) on the C-terminal tiles, and the disconfirmable position control passes (C-end residue effect 0.181 > same-residue internal 0.118, delta=0.064, p=1e-3); positive control reproduced (C-end G/A/W/Y unstable 0.56 > D/E/K stable 0.38, monotone). Effect below the crosses floor (|rho|<0.10) -> bounded_descriptor_only. Distinct from the N-end-rule endogenous-half-life layer. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

RBNS in-vitro k-mer affinity does NOT cross the readback boundary to predict eCLIP in-vivo binding BEYOND dinucleotide composition (pre-registered; new layer = RBP binding, in-vitro->in-vivo; conclusive negative). ENCODE RBNS + eCLIP for RBFOX2/HNRNPC/PUM1 (900 peaks + GC-matched controls, UCSC hg38 peak sequences); motifs ARE enriched in peaks (positive control passes: GCATG 0.49 vs 0.25, poly-U 0.92 vs 0.78, UGUA fold 20) and raw peak-vs-control affinity AUROC is weakly positive (0.53-0.59, label-perm p=5e-4), BUT the signal does not survive a dinucleotide-shuffle null (dinuc_null_p 0.40-0.60) and AUROC<0.60 with cross-RBP inconsistency -> composition_artifact. Honest caveat: for low-complexity motifs (poly-U) the dinuc-shuffle null is conservative-by-design (preserves the motif), so the negative for the 'beyond-dinuc-composition' claim partly reflects null design; n=300 peaks/RBP. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

PRDM9-A binding motif (external prior PWM) crosses the readback boundary to predict measured meiotic DSB hotspot strength beyond GC/CpG composition, with a passing allele-specific killer test AND falsification (pre-registered; new layer = meiotic recombination/DSB, DNA layer; conclusive crosses_boundary). Pratto 2014 DMC1 SSDS (GSE59836, 52963 hotspots with AA/AC strength, hg19); A-PWM->AA-strength partial rho=0.253 (perm p=1e-3, GC/CpG-controlled, all GC strata positive 0.30/0.22/0.17); the allele-specific differential (A-motif minus C-motif score)->(AA minus AC strength) rho=0.272 (p=1e-3, which GC/CpG composition cannot fake since it affects both alleles equally); and the real Altemose-2017 PRDM9-C PWM does NOT predict AA (falsification passes: C->AA rho=-0.024, A far more predictive, gap 0.278). Positive control reproduced (A-motif center-vs-flank enrichment 1.41). Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

CPE x PAS-distance grammar does NOT cross the readback boundary to predict measured somatic poly(A) tail length beyond 3'UTR length+GC+expression (pre-registered; new layer = poly(A) tail length; conclusive negative). Subtelny 2014 PAL-seq (GSE52809 HeLa n=6796 + yeast cross-organism); the codon-optimality angle is excluded a priori (Subtelny showed tail<->TE coupling is embryo-only, absent in somatic = disguised-e_in); the length-invariant CPE-grammar (CPEB UUUUAU relative to PAS, the uncharacterized-in-somatic-cells frontier) gives partial rho=-0.018 (p=0.13, n.s.) after controlling length+GC+log(RPKM), and is not cross-species concordant -> composition_artifact. Positive control reproduced (replication-dependent histone short tails 48.5 vs global median 87.5; RP genes 74.8) so the readout is valid -> a real negative: CPE-grammar (characterized in oocyte/embryo/neuron) does NOT operate on somatic tail length. Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

Extended stop-codon sequence context (beyond stop-identity + +4nt) crosses the readback boundary to predict measured G418-induced ribosome readthrough (RRTS) beyond stop-identity+4+3'UTR-length+GC, on held-out transcripts (pre-registered; new layer = translation termination; conclusive crosses_boundary). Wangen & Green eLife 52611 G418 sheet (n=4982 non-zero-RRTS transcripts); core positive control reproduced (UGA 0.42 > UAG 0.35 > UAA 0.31, UGA-C highest stop+4); nested held-out model adds delta R²=0.0154 from extended context over the stop-identity+4+log(UTR3)+GC baseline (perm p=1e-3, held-out not in-sample). Verdict crosses_boundary / bounded_descriptor_only / composition_artifact.

Branchpoint motif/PPT strength is a real but BOUNDED cross-layer contact for measured lariat coverage (a branchpoint-usage proxy), beyond intron length+GC+3'SS strength+BP-3'SS distance+gene expression (pre-registered; new layer = branchpoint usage; conclusive bounded). Mercer 2015 lariat-seq (PMC4315302, n=10584 high-confidence branchpoints with coverage+intron+GTEx-v8 expression, hg19); U2-prior motif+PPT partial rho=-0.048 (perm p=1e-3, beyond null95=0.019 but below the 0.10 crosses floor); positive control reproduced (BP-3'SS distance median 25nt, 92.7% in 18-40nt, branchpoint-A 78.4%); circularity guarded (main readout = continuous coverage not 0/1 detection; motif<->detection rho=-0.032 ~ 0).
